_comment: Project definitions. Edit this file, then run: python tools/build.py. Photos come from Photos/<folder> in filename order -- that order is the sequence the project page renders, so name them 01, 02, 03. Ratings never reorder a project.

projects.summary: A training-floor session for activewear label Cloka: lifting under the gym's orange and teal light, apparel worn in use rather than staged, and close detail on the branding itself.
projects._cover_note: Set to null to let the build pick the highest-rated frame. It chose 13.jpg (the logo macro) — technically the sharpest, but a detail shot makes a weak campaign card, so 11 is named explicitly: product worn in use, branding fully legible, the shoot's teal/orange light at its strongest.

projects.title: Almost Three
projects.subtitle: Maternity shoot · December 2025
projects.summary: A winter maternity session on a coastal causeway, timed so the sun sat low behind the water for the last of it. Red tulle against bare trees and a hard blue sky, close enough to catch the small moments between the two of them — and the dog got a frame of its own.

projects.title: Abhinaya
projects.subtitle: Classical dance recital · 2026
projects.summary: A solo recital shot tight against a black stage, where the only light is the one the performer is standing in. The set moves between full posture and the details the form actually lives in: the mudras of the hands, the alta on the fingers, and the expression carrying the story.
